decision.trend: Research has been focused on developing high-entropy alloys with improved properties such as strength, ductility, and thermal conductivity. Recent studies have explored the effects of chemical short-range order and the formation of ordered clusters on the lattice thermal conductivity of refractory high-entropy alloys. Additionally, computational methods have been developed to reduce the cost of calculating ab initio melting properties for multi-component high-entropy alloys while maintaining sub-meV accuracy.
decision.unsolved: The development of high-entropy alloys with optimal superconducting properties remains a challenge.
